description: This file contains a Smarty plugin for rendering HTML radio button groups, including functions for generating radio inputs and their labels, with configurable parameters and error handling.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios
methods.description: Generates a list of HTML radio input elements based on provided parameters, handling options, values, and attributes.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios_output
methods.description: Creates the HTML for a single radio input and its label, handling object conversion and escaping.
